scope: 142 newly recognized attack components, 86 fully supported additional cards; no previous supported program or metadata changes.

sources.title: Advanced Player’s Rulebook 3.4
sources.checkedFacts: C-01: discarding moves physical cards to their owners discard; one multi-unit Energy may satisfy several required Energy. C-09: effect attachment is separate from the manual attachment. D-05: attacks may choose zero for up-to effects. E-33: private-hand Energy selection remains private and follows its stated limits.

sources.title: Ultra Necrozma-GX official strategy
sources.checkedFacts: Photon Geyser discards all basic Psychic Energy from its source and adds 80 damage per discarded card to its base damage.

sources.title: Necrozma-GX
sources.checkedFacts: Prismatic Burst discards all attached Psychic Energy and adds 60 damage for each discarded card. Unlike Photon Geyser, it is not limited to basic Energy.

boundaries: Damage bonuses count physical cards actually discarded; a multi-unit Special Energy card contributes one discarded card.
Attached type filtering uses current supplied type; Basic-only constraints exclude Special Energy. Private-zone typed Energy selection uses the printed Basic Energy identity.
Attack costs are paid before the discard checkpoint; discarding those Energy does not retroactively invalidate the declared attack.
Public Energy selection validates owner, host, attachment instance, cap and replay. Hand selection validates private card identity and printed category/type.
Optional and up-to attacks may select zero. This does not imply arbitrary omission of mandatory public recovery counts.
Effect attachment retains source and destination ownership, per-card distribution and the separate manual attachment quota.
Three incomplete-card drafts are test resources only. No previous supported programs, metadata or engine changes. Artwork excluded.
